{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the count of converted customers
count_converted = len(converted_customers)

# Print both values
print(f'Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted}')
print(f'Number of converted customers: {count_converted}')"}
